purpose: Q-23 lossless compression pilot on the existing 24 deterministic smoke logits (no new sample processed)
command: <m2 venv>/bin/pip install zstandard; <m2 venv>/bin/python tools/m2a_compression_pilot.py run3 --sweep; ... tools/m2a_compression_pilot.py runC --sweep; pip freeze --all > environments/m2_preprocess_laptop.lock.txt
notes: Dependency added for lossless storage only; lock and runtime facts regenerated with the reason recorded. Projected M2B footprint 37.5 GB against 66 GB free on /media/cong/Data - reported to the owner, not a blocker.
scientific_decision: Q-23 RESOLVED_BY_OWNER_FLOAT32_FULL_LOGITS. Storage npy1+shuffle4+zstd level 10 (zstandard 0.25.0 / libzstd 1.5.7), 256 rows per shard. Level 10 chosen operationally: level 19 costs ~33x encode time for 0.9% space. No float16 fallback was considered.

purpose: Correct a weakness in the smoke comparison tool found while validating the rerun
